narr: An unusually moist pattern for mid-May was in place over Arizona with precipitable water values around 200-250% of normal. This allowed for the development of strong thunderstorms with heavy rain and flooding.
ev: A Yavapai County Alert gauge on Black Canyon Creek showed about a two foot rise at 1040 PM. A downstream gauge (Auga Fria--AFRA3) showed a rise at 200 AM on April 20. The river remained elevated through the evening of May 23.
Heavy rain caused flooding along Highway 69 in Prescott Valley. Rose Creek flooded Hornet Drive.
